caption:
You don't get fast by watching fast. 🥊

Same dream, two plans. One hits the bag 10 minutes a day. One watches fights. Day 30, out of breath. Next day, he hits again. A year later: 180 punches a minute vs 912 fights watched.

Listen to the combos get faster.

Send this to someone who says "I could do that."

#boxing #practice #discipline #habits #motivation
